# IJG JPEG decoder sources

These sources are the decoder subset of [Independent JPEG Group release 10](https://www.ijg.org/files/). The source archive `jpegsrc.v10.tar.gz` has SHA-256 `8b9eaa13242690ebd03e1728ab1edf97a81a78ed6e83624d493655f31ac95ab5`.

The distribution omits the CLI tools, encoder sources, and files unrelated to the library build. The source files and original `README` are included verbatim. The included `jconfig.h` was generated by the release's configure script for Linux. Mycela's build script and C bridge live outside this directory.
